#summary This page describes how to add new widgets to the editor

The editor allows to register new widgets to display specific attributes. In the example model, the E-Mail attribute could be rendered by an E-Mail widget, which offers an additional button to send mails. New widgets are registered via the extension points *org.unicase.ui.meeditor.attributecontrols* for attributes and *org.unicase.ui.meeditor.referencecontrols* for references.

The following example registers the E-Mail control included in the example plugins.

{{{
   <extension
         point="org.unicase.ui.meeditor.attributecontrols">
      <widget
            class="examplemodel.editorcustomizations.EMailMEControl"
            name="exampleModel.editorCustomizations.widget1"
            showLabel="true"
            type="java.lang.String">
      </widget>
   </extension>
}}}

A widget implements two methods. 'canRender()' determines, whether the widget will render a specific attribute.

{{{
@Override
	public int canRender(IItemPropertyDescriptor arg0, EObject arg1) {
		Object feature = arg0.getFeature(arg1);
		if (feature.equals(LibraryPackage.eINSTANCE.getWriter_EMail())) {
			return 2;
		}
		return DO_NOT_RENDER;
	}

	@Override
	public Control createControl(Composite parent, int style) {

		//Create controls here

		return composite;
	}
}}}
